title: feat/visual-artifacts: manual test checklist
subtitle: What automated tests and the headless browser could not cover

sections.title: Manual tests for the visual artifact skills
sections.label: Before merge
sections.intro:
This branch adds two skills to the `portable-artifacts` plugin and brings a third to v2:

- **make-dashboard** (v2) builds an interactive dashboard from data files, with live reload.
- **make-diagram** (new) draws architecture, flow, sequence and state diagrams as one HTML file.
- **make-explainer** (new) turns a small JSON outline into a recap, concept page, slide deck or this checklist.

Unit tests, the schema checks and a headless Chromium run already cover rendering, validation and storage. Only the items below need a person: a fresh machine, a real window, a print dialog. Items tagged **Regression** guard bugs fixed during review.

**Fixed during review**

- make-diagram: edge ids can no longer collide, a group highlight stays visible, and self-loops are easier to read.
- make-dashboard: stacked-area crosshair dots sit on the coloured areas, nominal x keeps query order, and a paired card keeps its tab row.
- make-explainer: an SVG check scans the whole file, and section ids stay unique.

items.text: `npx skills add abhijitbansal/claude-skills --skill make-explainer` installs the skill and both sibling skills it needs
items.note: run it on a machine that has none of the three

items.text: Installing `make-diagram` alone leaves `make-explainer` absent, and `make-explainer` names the exact install command
`/make-explainer` appears in a new Claude Code session after installing
Removing the skill from `~/.claude/skills` leaves no stray files behind
Paper, Ink, Blueprint and Editorial each build a page with readable body text
The theme toggle cycles Auto, Light and Dark, and the choice survives a reload
Dark mode follows the system setting with no flash of the light page on load
items.note: switch macOS appearance while the page is open

items.text: Status chips stay legible in all four themes without relying on colour
Each dashboard kind renders its chart, and the Table view sorts by clicking a header
The view switcher moves with the arrow keys and announces the selected view
A paired card keeps its tab row when only one pane has data
A chart with zero rows shows an empty state and the other views still open
A card exports to PNG, SVG and CSV, and each file opens in its own app
The exported SVG keeps the card's fonts and colours when opened in a browser
Printing the explainer to PDF opens every collapsed section and drops the contents list
items.note: use the system print dialog, not a screenshot

items.text: `serve.mjs --watch` rebuilds the dashboard after saving a data file
Rebuild now refreshes the data without losing the selected view
A broken data file shows the error on the page and the last good chart stays
`--interval` above 86400 seconds is refused with a clear message
Hovering a node traces its edges and dims everything else
The Present overlay opens full screen, steps through reveals and closes with Escape
A self-loop edge is readable and does not overlap its own node
A group highlight stays visible against the page in dark mode
Ticks survive a reload, and reordering the items in the JSON keeps them
Editing one item's text clears that tick only
A page opened with storage blocked shows the unsaved note and still lets you tick items
items.note: private window with site data blocked

items.text: Reset asks inline and never opens a browser dialog
A heading ending in an exclamation mark is rejected by `validate.mjs`

sections.onFail:
- Leave the box unticked and write down the step, what you saw and what you expected.
- Check the [open issues](https://github.com/abhijitbansal/claude-skills/issues) for the same symptom before filing a new one.
- After the fix, re-run the failed item and every **Regression** item in its group.
